lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 8-10 high-luminance circular spots arranged in two primary horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the gill region. The primary mid-flank row displays consistent spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are present across the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine luminance patterns consisting of interconnected light-colored lines located immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into discrete spots further down the flank.
